headline: BI Rate Rises to 6%, Market Players Reveal Effect on Stocks-Mutual Funds
summary: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark interest rate to 6%. Market participants are assessing the effects on stocks and mutual funds.
why: The BI Rate is Indonesia's key policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields and the rupiah.
why_moved: Higher policy rates generally raise domestic borrowing costs, which can weigh on equity valuations and bond prices.
original_headline: BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%, Pelaku Pasar Ungkap Efeknya ke Saham-Reksa Dana
